description: Defines the QuicProxyClientSocket class, a network socket implementation that tunnels data over a QUIC stream, including its interface, member variables, and related classes.

classes.name: QuicProxyClientSocket
classes.description: A socket class that tunnels data over a QUIC stream, managing connection, data transfer, and authentication.

methods.name: QuicProxyClientSocket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the socket with a QUIC stream, session, proxy info, and other parameters.

methods.name: ~QuicProxyClientSocket
methods.description: Destructor that calls Disconnect() on destruction.

methods.name: GetConnectResponseInfo
methods.description: Returns the response info from the CONNECT request.

methods.name: SetStreamPriority
methods.description: Sets the priority of the underlying stream.

methods.name: IsConnectedAndIdle
methods.description: Checks if socket is connected and idle.

methods.name: WasEverUsed
methods.description: Indicates if the socket was ever used.

methods.name: ApplySocketTag
methods.description: Applies a socket tag for traffic management.
